source_identity.canonical_title: Le whataboutisme ne fait avancer aucune cause

translation.summary: Even if feminism decided to take an interest in violence against men, people would continue to reproach it for failing to address one cause or another. It is endless and does not move matters forward.

citations.translated_citation: The '''''whataboutism''''', also found in the form '''''whataboutery''''' and sometimes rendered in French as '''whataboutisme''', is a [https://wiki.froth.zone/wiki/Sophisme?lang=fr fallacy] intended to deflect criticism by referring to other real or alleged grievances. The ''[https://wiki.froth.zone/wiki/Oxford_English_Dictionary?lang=fr Oxford English Dictionary]'' defines the term as a “technique or practice of responding to an accusation or difficult question by making a counter-accusation or raising a different issue.
